name: Create Song
description: Create a complete Suno-ready song package with style prompt + lyrics + parameters through guided creative conversation.

name: Refine Song
description: Bring back a Suno take: diagnose what's off and rebuild the changed parts of the package (uses the Feedback Loop inside).

name: Browse Songbook
description: Browse past songs and successful prompts from your creative history.

name: Save Memory
description: Save current session context to Mac's memory for next time.

name: Manage Bands
description: Create, edit, list, duplicate, or delete band identity profiles with genre, vocal direction, and writer voice.

name: Analyze Writer Voice
description: Extract writing voice patterns from samples and store in a band profile.

name: Profile Health Check
description: Assess profile completeness and quality beyond structural validation.

name: Manage Playlist
description: Scaffold or edit a band's canonical playlist YAML: add, reorder, or rename tracks.

name: Build Style Prompt
description: Generate model-aware Suno style prompts with creativity modes, wild card variants, and exclusion prompts optimized for your chosen model tier.

name: Transform Lyrics
description: Transform poems and text into Suno-ready structured lyrics with metatags and cliche detection.

name: Analyze Lyrics
description: Analyze raw text for song structure potential without transforming — returns structure analysis, syllable patterns, and character budget.

name: Feedback Loop
description: Diagnose a Suno take on its own: translate reactions into concrete parameter adjustments (Mac's Refine Song calls this inside).

name: Analyze Audio
description: Measure a render's tempo, key and loudness, plus a section map against its lyrics when the PyTorch audio tools are on.

name: Sequence Playlist
description: Order tracks into an album-craft playlist: energy arcs, Camelot transitions, locked arcs, encore design, with per-move rationale.
